biomeOverrides.reason: Garry oak habitat and gardens; avoid treating the word Hill as a mountain biome.
Saanich describes numerous natural areas and Kings Pond in this urban park; the name Hill alone does not imply mountain biome.
Saanich describes gardens, ponds, Lochside Creek, and a bird/nature sanctuary; use marsh for its wet habitat.
View Royal describes forested trails and the parks plan identifies older forest; the name Hill alone does not imply mountain biome.

rank69.decision: retain municipal-district-of-north-saanich-1850 as Bazan Bay Park; use its matching current CRD OID 1850 polygon; do not label it Cy Hampson Park
evidence: North Saanich 2025 OCP Schedule C map is GIS-sourced and labels Bazan Bay Park separately from Cy Hampson Park.

The official access guide lists East end Bazan Bay Rd as access #6 with Parking 10, Dist 20 m, access ease M, kayak-launch rating M, and swim rating N; it separately lists Cy Hampson Park South/North as #5a/#5b.
The live CRD polygon selected by the preserved ID is OID 1850 and its Name attribute is Bazan Bay Park.

The Cy Hampson Park web page says that Cy Hampson Park was established in 1976 as Bazan Bay Park; that historical statement does not override the current OCP map's separate labels or the current CRD OID 1850 identity.
rank69.descriptionGuard: Use only mapped identity and the access guide facts above; do not reuse Cy Hampson's pebble beach/trail copy or assert an area for OID 1850.
